headline: Tourists come but spend little. World Bank points to the problem
summary: Kyrgyzstan attracts more foreign tourists, but visitor growth is not matched by a comparable rise in hotel and related revenue, the World Bank said. Visitors are spending little.
why: Tourist spending per visitor drives hotel and service revenues, so weak spending limits returns for hospitality businesses.
original_headline: Туристы приезжают, но тратят мало. Всемирный банк указал на проблему
